README.md
content:
# Autographer Annotator

## What changed

This version replaces the unreliable deep-folder browser.

Click **Open JPG** and choose any one JPG in the Autographer image folder using the native Windows file chooser. The app identifies that JPG's folder and
loads every JPG in the same folder.

## Features

- native single-JPG selection;
- automatic loading of all JPGs in the selected folder;
- play, pause, stop, previous, next, faster and slower controls;
- image-number slider;
- keyboard shortcuts;
- all images default to INDOORS;
- large OUTDOORS/INDOORS toggle control;
- persistent per-image classifications that are not changed by moving backwards;
- clicking the toggle while reviewing an earlier image overrides that image and controls subsequently viewed images;
- clear indoor/outdoor indicator over the image;
- indoor/outdoor transition logging;
- interval and total-minute tables;
- automatic CSV saving on Finish review;
- archive option that moves images into an `Archived` subfolder;
- permanent deletion only after results have been saved;
- typed confirmation before deletion;
- Exit button.

## Install packages

```r
install.packages(c("shiny", "shinyjs"))
```

## Run

Open `app.R` in RStudio and click **Run App**, or run:

```r
shiny::runApp("C:/path/to/autographer_annotator")
```

## Keyboard shortcuts

- Space: play or pause
- Right arrow: next image
- Left arrow: previous image
- O: toggle the active classification between OUTDOORS and INDOORS

## Output files

Pressing **Finish review** creates:

```text
Autographer_review_results
```

inside the selected image folder.

It saves:

- `intervals_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.csv`
- `markers_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.csv`
- `totals_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.csv`

## Timestamp warning

The app reads Autographer timestamps from filenames where possible. If the
camera clock was wrong, absolute dates and clock times will also be wrong.
Durations between consecutive images remain valid only if the camera clock ran
consistently.

## Image removal

**Archive all images** moves them into an `Archived` subfolder.

**Delete all images** permanently deletes them. Deletion is blocked until the
review tables have been saved.
